name: Amazonia Theaters
description: Two grand opera houses stand deep in the Brazilian Amazon: the Theatro da Paz in Belém and the Teatro Amazonas in Manaus. Both were built with rubber-boom fortunes, and each sits beside a public square. Modelled on French and European theatres yet decorated with Amazon motifs, they were meant to show off the ambition of their cities. Manaus still hosts an annual opera festival.
